slides.title: Arsi, Oromia: night attack reported
slides.body: Borkena reported at least 47 Orthodox Christian farmers killed in Shirka Woreda. Not independently verified.

slides.title: South Gondar, Amhara: school hit
slides.body: A drone strike reportedly hit Sana Elementary on Oct. 20, killing at least 6 children (Borkena, Addis Standard).

slides.title: Fled from Moyale into Kenya
slides.body: Humanitarian officials cited by Anadolu, after clashes between Oromia and Somali regional forces.

slides.title: Tigray civil servants unpaid
slides.body: Salaries unpaid since March, Al Jazeera reported, as shops and banks reopen in Mekelle.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
